headline: Highway 1 Access and State Park Reservations
reservation: Overnight stays in Big Sur require booking months in advance through the official state portal or private lodging sites. Day-use at Pfeiffer Beach is managed via a separate fee system and parking is not guaranteed. Always check Caltrans for Highway 1 closures, as landslides frequently disrupt through-traffic.

days.title: Redwoods and Iconic Vistas

stops.name: Bixby Creek Bridge
stops.detail: Observe the historic arch bridge from designated northern pullouts; never stop on the bridge itself.

stops.name: Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park
stops.detail: Walk the Valley View Trail for a look at the Big Sur River and ancient coastal redwoods.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 to 2 hours; traffic and fog significantly impact travel times
days.note: Fog is frequent in summer mornings; stay within designated viewpoints for safety.

days.title: Coastal Bluffs and Falls
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Big Sur Village

stops.name: Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park
stops.detail: View McWay Falls dropping into the ocean from the established overlook trail.

stops.name: Pfeiffer Beach
stops.detail: Visit the shoreline to see Keyhole Rock; check for parking availability before descending Sycamore Canyon Road.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; Sycamore Canyon Road is narrow and steep
days.note: The beach below McWay Falls is strictly closed to the public; remain on the Overlook Trail.

days.title: Northern Headlands
days.start: Suggested: 8 AM from Big Sur Village

stops.name: Andrew Molera State Park
stops.detail: Explore the Creamery Meadow Trail for a more open, meadow-to-beach hiking experience.

stops.name: Point Sur State Historic Park
stops.detail: View the volcanic rock and lighthouse from the highway or check for official guided tour availability.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; check for seasonal river crossings at Andrew Molera
days.note: Ocean temperatures are cold with dangerous rip currents; avoid swimming.

intel.title: Legal Pullouts
intel.text: Parking is strictly enforced; use only gravel turnouts that allow your vehicle to be fully clear of the white line. Pfeiffer Beach parking often fills by 10 AM on weekends.

intel.title: Connectivity Limits
intel.text: Expect no cellular service between Carmel and San Simeon. Download all reservation confirmations and navigation data for offline use before departing Monterey.

intel.title: Strategic Refueling
intel.text: Fuel prices in Big Sur Village are significantly higher than in Monterey or Carmel. Fill your tank before entering the coastal corridor to ensure coverage for return trips.

intel.title: Peak Season Traffic
intel.text: Travel during spring and fall midweek periods to avoid the heaviest congestion. Saturday traffic can double the transit time between Bixby Bridge and McWay Falls.

intel.title: Highway 1 Status
intel.text: Major sections of Highway 1 can close for months due to winter storm damage. Consult the Caltrans QuickMap for real-time road status before starting your drive.

plan.arrival: Pick up your vehicle at Monterey Regional Airport (MRY) and secure supplies in Carmel-by-the-Sea. Drive south while it is light to navigate the winding coastal cliffs safely.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are ideal for Highway 1; large RVs face length restrictions on specific curves and limited parking at viewpoints.
plan.goldenHour: The cliffs near Bixby Bridge offer classic sunset views, though marine layers may obscure the horizon seasonally.
